svg.title: Text-to-SQL Workflow Environment diagram
svg.desc: Inventory: top user question feeds through a brace and arrow to a Language Models box, then a downward arrow to an SQL/code panel. The large workflow environment contains a Database section with diverse systems and real app icons above example schema tables, a Documents section listing metadata/external knowledge/dialect docs/query interface with document icons, and a Codebase section listing folders/files/dbt assets. Bidirectional feedback arrows connect the workflow environment and the SQL panel. Symmetry basis: left workflow environment and right model/code region are separated horizontally; the database panel uses row-wise equipartition of source icons and schema tables; documents/codebase are vertically stacked. SAM mappings are confirmed from annotated overview and source_crop coordinates: constructed draft icon groups map one-to-one to supplied asset_sam_region picture crops and replacement images are placed at their original coordinates with translate(0,0); outer frames/text/arrows remain native SVG.

text.tspan: I need a daily report on key sales activities—covering tasks completed,
events held, leads generated, and the status of opportunities.
